documentation.content:
Severity: SEV-2
Owner: Technical Ops
Threshold: more than 4 Cloud Run 5xx responses in 5 minutes for any production service.
Expected response: acknowledge within 15 minutes and review Cloud Run logs plus /health and /status.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx" AND (resource.labels.service_name="openstaff-api" OR resource.labels.service_name="openstaff-web" OR resource.labels.service_name="openstaff-admin")
